title_en: Newly Furnished 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale Near Delijorgjit Complex
description_en: Near the Delijorgji Complex, Newly Furnished 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale The apartment is located on the 11th floor of a new building in front of the Delijorgji complex, it has a total area of ​​110 m², of which 90 m² of interior area + 20 m² of veranda.
